text_block_list.text: I'm out in the courtyard during lunch talking to Biwa Hayahide, when…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two! You seen Brian anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, not today. Why do you ask? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's not a big deal or anything. I made her lunch, but forgot to give it to her.
choice_data_list: You made lunch for Narita Brian?
You made lunch for Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yep. That girl is picky as heck, though. There's only a handful of things she'll actually eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But I figure I can't just let her starve, so I make her lunch every now and again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My sister's diet is beyond unbalanced, so your efforts are appreciated, Hishi.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I still remember the difficulties I faced whenever I used to make curry for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She'd stop eating it altogether if she detected even a hint of vegetables, so I had to try many combinations until it was just right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'd have to mince and stew the veggies for hours, but once I achieved the right taste, she couldn't get enough!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Wow, it's hard to imagine her being so spoiled now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well… That was quite some time ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As for these days, forget about cooking―we hardly even have the chance to eat together at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I bet she'd still happily gobble up your food. Why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't think so… That was long ago, and our relationship isn't what it once was.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We don't live together anymore, so suddenly pushing food upon her would be rather awk—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, don't be nuts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You think too much. You just gotta do it! Act first, and figure out the rest later!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You and me—we're gonna cook up somethin' after school today. See you in the cafeteria kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You better be there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …I didn't even have a chance to object.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well… I can't simply ignore her, so I suppose I'll have to go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to make something that'll knock Brian's socks off!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm… The question is, what should that something be?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Care to offer your thoughts on the matter, Trainer?
choice_data_list: A nutritious curry to give her strength.
A thick hamburger steak to boost her stamina.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nice! That oughta bring back some good memories for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's been quite some time since I made curry for her. I hardly remember the recipe anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot deny that curry is a good choice. Vegetables, meat, and carbohydrates, all on one plate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Although I don't recall the exact recipe, I'll do my best to replicate the flavor.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …And, it's finished!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How curious, though. It's been years, yet somehow I remembered precisely what to do at every step.
choice_data_list: All that hard work really sunk in, huh?
All that hard work really sunk in, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …That smell sure brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: In the flesh… I knew this had to be my sister's curry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mind if I tear in? I was just about to scrounge up a snack.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's Big Sis's curry, all right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll have seconds.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh! O-of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha! Look at that face!
Watching her little sister eat, Biwa Hayahide can't even begin to hide her joy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm… An interesting proposal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Stamina is essential for tempering a strong body… Hamburger steak it is, then!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I do recall having made hamburger steak occasionally. It wasn't always curry, of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In fact, hamburger steak afforded me an even greater chance to sneak some vegetables in without her noticing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I do the same thing! As long as it still looks and tastes like meat, it usually passes the test.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian's palate is a lot simpler than you'd think.
The two of them chat away as they prepare a meal for Narita Brian. Until…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And it's done! One stealthy hamburger steak with extra hidden vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The veggies are mixed into the sauce, too, as opposed to just the—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You seem to be having a good time, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian?! Wh-what are you doing here…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Amazon told me to come. Apparently there's something you want me to eat?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sorry for not tellin' you… But since you went through all the trouble of cooking, I wanted to make sure it paid off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Of course you did. Well, I suppose the cat's out of the bag.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm, pretty good. Meat is the best. It gives me energy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hehe, looks like it worked, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, so it did.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you two mumbling about?
The two of them keep Narita Brian company as she finishes off the lovingly prepared hamburger steak.
